Coral is a marine animal, and many reef-building corals produce hard skeletons. The animals need not occur together. Seaweed names marine algae. Plankton drift with water currents, while a Shipwreck is the remains of a damaged or sunken vessel. The guide keeps organism names separate from the human-made wreck.
